section: Using Tekton Results for OpenShift Pipelines observability
job_statement: When managing pipeline operations at scale, I want to preserve complete execution history beyond the lifecycle of CRs, so I can maintain long-term observability and compliance without resource bloat.
desired_outcomes: Minimize storage overhead from keeping live CRs
Ensure complete audit trail is preserved
Enable historical analysis without performance impact
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Assembly header and abstract, lines 59-66
notes: Core observability job - archives PipelineRun and TaskRun information after CR deletion

section: Tekton Results concepts
job_statement: When working with archived pipeline data, I want to understand how results and records are structured, so I can query the correct resources and interpret the data.
parent_job: Preserve complete execution history beyond the lifecycle of CRs
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to locate specific execution data
Reduce errors from querying wrong resource types
Ensure understanding of result vs record distinction
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Section 'Tekton Results concepts', lines 74-247
notes: Conceptual understanding - covers results (containers) vs records (individual run data), naming conventions, and data preservation

section: Configuring Tekton Results
job_statement: When enabling observability for pipelines, I want to ensure Tekton Results is properly configured, so I can capture the data I need without manual intervention.
desired_outcomes: Minimize configuration complexity
Ensure all required data is captured
Reduce likelihood of misconfiguration
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Section 'Configuring Tekton Results', lines 256-267
notes: Main configuration job - Tekton Results enabled by default but requires additional configuration for logging

section: Configuring LokiStack forwarding for logging information
job_statement: When I need to query pipeline run logs after CR deletion, I want to configure log forwarding to LokiStack, so I can preserve and retrieve complete execution logs.
parent_job: Ensure Tekton Results is properly configured
desired_outcomes: Ensure logging information is preserved beyond CR lifecycle
Minimize data loss from deleted runs
Enable log queries through Tekton Results API
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Section 'Configuring LokiStack forwarding', lines 275-398
notes: Critical for log retention - without this, Tekton Results cannot store or retrieve logging information

section: Configuring an external database server
job_statement: When preparing for production workloads, I want to connect Tekton Results to an external PostgreSQL database, so I can ensure production-grade capabilities like backups and performance tuning.
parent_job: Ensure Tekton Results is properly configured
desired_outcomes: Ensure production-grade database reliability
Enable automated backups and lifecycle management
Reduce risk of data loss from default internal instance
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Section 'Configuring an external database server', lines 406-454
notes: Production requirement - default internal PostgreSQL is for testing only, lacks production features

section: Configuring the retention policy for Tekton Results
job_statement: When managing storage costs and compliance, I want to configure automated retention policies, so I can remove older results without manual intervention while meeting retention requirements.
parent_job: Ensure Tekton Results is properly configured
desired_outcomes: Minimize storage resource consumption
Ensure compliance retention periods are met
Reduce manual cleanup operations
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Section 'Configuring the retention policy', lines 462-500
notes: Default is indefinite retention - must configure to prevent unlimited storage growth

section: Observability metrics for Tekton Results
job_statement: When monitoring Tekton Results health and performance, I want to track storage latency and deletion metrics, so I can identify performance issues and data loss risks.
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to detect storage failures
Reduce likelihood of undetected data loss
Ensure visibility into deletion timing
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Section 'Observability metrics for Tekton Results', lines 508-603
notes: Metrics exposed by tekton-results-watcher on port 9090 - covers storage performance, failures, deletion duration and count

section: Querying Tekton Results for results and records
job_statement: When investigating pipeline execution history, I want to query archived results and records, so I can analyze past runs and troubleshoot issues.
prerequisites: Install opc utility (via tkn CLI package)
Configure authentication for Tekton Results API
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to locate specific pipeline runs
Ensure complete execution history is accessible
Reduce dependency on live CRs for investigation
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Section 'Querying Tekton Results for results and records', lines 611-622
notes: Uses opc CLI utility - can query by name, UUID, or CEL expressions

section: Preparing the opc utility environment for querying Tekton Results
job_statement: When setting up to query Tekton Results, I want to configure the opc utility with API endpoint and authentication, so I can execute queries without repeated credential entry.
desired_outcomes: Minimize authentication friction for queries
Reduce likelihood of authentication errors
Enable automated query workflows
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Section 'Preparing the opc utility environment', lines 630-683
notes: One-time setup - can use token or service account, optional results.yaml file for automation

section: Querying for results and records by name
job_statement: When I know the specific pipeline run or result I need, I want to retrieve it by name or UUID, so I can quickly access the full YAML manifest and logs.
prerequisites: Configure log forwarding to LokiStack (for logs)
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to retrieve specific run data
Ensure complete YAML manifest is accessible
Enable log retrieval after CR deletion
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Section 'Querying for results and records by name', lines 691-786
notes: Direct lookup by name - format is namespace/results/uuid for results, includes records/uuid for individual records

section: Searching for results
job_statement: When looking for pipeline runs matching specific criteria, I want to search results using CEL queries, so I can find runs by status, annotations, or other attributes.
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to find runs matching criteria
Reduce need to inspect individual runs manually
Enable filtering by success/failure status
evidence: records-combined.adoc -> Section 'Searching for results', lines 794-826

section: Searching for records
job_statement: When investigating pipeline behavior patterns, I want to search records using CEL queries on full YAML data, so I can find runs by completion time, labels, task counts, or any manifest field.

Reduce manual inspection of individual records
